source_text: Sanctum sanctorum est; in atrio comedatur. Non foris dogmata sancta spargere. Intra ecclesiam edere.
pass_a_gloss: Holy of-holies it-is; in court let-it-be-eaten. Not outside doctrines holy to-scatter. Within church to-eat.
pass_b_english: It is [[most holy; let it be eaten in the court >> Bible:Leviticus 6:26]]. Do not scatter holy teaching outdoors. Eat within the church.
